project.name: PayProofly
project.status: Architecture defined. Ready to build Builder.

importantProjectPrinciple.rule: Work sequentially. Define one objective, complete it, verify it, then move to the next objective.

freecashMaster.importantRule: The six existing Freecash pages are the visual and structural reference. Do not redesign them while building the Builder.

masterSchema.role: Official data contract between AI and Builder

freecashSchema.role: Complete populated Freecash example based on the real Freecash pages and current research

schemas.relationship: schemaVersion-1.0.json defines the structure. schemaFreecash-1.0.json is a complete real-world implementation of that structure.

programmaticSEOArchitecture.model: One JSON per app generates six pages

responsibilities: Create different editorial content for each search intent
AI.output: One validated application JSON based on schemaVersion 1.0

doesNotDo: Decide whether an app is legitimate
Modify the Master JSON schema automatically

contentArchitecture.principle: General factual information belongs in structured data. Editorial page-specific content belongs in pages.

contentBlocks.importantRule: sections must remain arrays because each page can contain a different number and combination of sections.

urlGeneration.rule: URLs are generated automatically from app.slug and page intent.

internalLinking.rule: The Builder should generate the app hub and all five intent-page links automatically from app.slug.

freecashEditorialRules.paymentProof: Never claim PayProofly personally tested a Freecash payment unless a real test was performed.
freecashEditorialRules.earnings: Advertised maximums must not be presented as typical earnings.
freecashEditorialRules.bonus: Do not permanently hardcode volatile promotional codes.
freecashEditorialRules.controversies: Attribute claims to the source and include the company's response where relevant.
freecashEditorialRules.companyClaims: Company-reported numbers must be attributed to Freecash and not presented as independently audited.

currentFreecashFactsUsedAsReference.typicalProcessing: Most withdrawals can take up to 30 minutes
currentFreecashFactsUsedAsReference.bankProcessing: Some bank transfers can take up to 3 business days
currentFreecashFactsUsedAsReference.signUpBonus: $10 account credit for eligible new users under the applicable promotion
currentFreecashFactsUsedAsReference.important: Offers, bonuses, withdrawal methods, minimums and eligibility can vary by region and change over time.

importantLessons.css: Do not alter styles.css while building the Builder unless explicitly required.
importantLessons.freecashFolders: All six Freecash folders are siblings under the project root. Intent pages are NOT nested inside /freecash/.
importantLessons.json: JSON contains structured data and content, not HTML.
importantLessons.builder: Builder should be dumb but reliable: validate and render.
importantLessons.templates: HTML structure should be fixed in Builder templates while content comes from JSON.
importantLessons.editorialFreedom: AI may write different content for each intent, but must remain within the schema and factual requirements.
importantLessons.scalability: The same Builder must work for Freecash, Prime Opinion and eventually all planned apps.
importantLessons.verification: Before generating other apps, Builder must successfully reproduce the Freecash reference.
